column3: Tomorrow's Kyoto
The day after the Siscaly tournament.
I took the chance for a stroll during the sunset to take a break from studying.
Ah, hello?
Kyou-chan, are you free right now?
Yeah.
...So? What's up?
I want to tell you that I'll be going early tomorrow.
Eh? Is there something tomorrow?
Why... There's the school trip tomorrow!
AH!
Crap... I totally forgot about it!
There was the Siscaly tournament, so I forgot how soon it was...
I-I'm such an idiot!
Kyou-chan, are you all right?
You're not going to tell me you "haven't prepared anything", right?
That's exactly what it is... Everything about this school trip had completely disappeared from my mind, including the preparation.
H-How should I say this...
What's wrong? Your voice's kinda shaky.
Oh... how should I put it, I'm in trouble.
I already felt like it wasn't right when I saw that you left your school trip handbook at school...
Ehh! Seriously?!
From what it sounds like, Kyou-chan, you didn't check the contents?
I didn't! Was there something of importance?!
There's a sticker in it that's used for the group activity for that very day.
This is bad--! Should I sneak into the school right now?!
I-It's not necessary for you to do that. I took Kyou-chan's handbook with me as a precaution.
As expected from Manami! That's my childhood friend! I'm coming over to your place right now!!
Oh, isn't that Onii-san?
That voice... could it be...
I turned around, and there stood--
A-Ayase...
Good day, Onii-san. What are you in such a hurry for?
Aragaki Ayase. Kirino's close friend, as well as her modeling colleague.
In other words, her "official" friend.
Besides my sister, Ayase is the prettiest person I've met so far.
Honestly, as far as appearances goes, she's totally my type but...
Could it be... that you're plotting lewd things against Kirino again...
Is that the only explanation you could come up to explain my sprint...?
And what's with that "again"? There hasn't been a single time where I've planned anything lewd against her since she was born!
Looking at the breathless perverted Onii-san running like that, anyone would agree.
Ugh...!
That's right. Because of various reasons, Ayase firmly believes I'm a pervert.
Because of many complicated reasons that entwine together, resolving that misunderstanding is impossible.
So to me, Ayase is a problematic person in many ways.
Fate sure is ironic...
Hmm? Did you say something?
No, nothing.
So please don't press your personal alarm button just yet.
That aside, weren't you in a hurry?
Ah, now that you mention it...
However, it's rare for you to start a conversation with me, so I might as well...
I merely saw Onii-san and greeted you.
There wasn't a particular reason, so I'll take my leave now.
And there she goes...
Good grief, my heart is moved every time she makes that angelic face. She truly is a devil...
Wait, I shouldn't be thinking of these things right now. I need to hurry to Manami's place!
Oh, Onii-san?
Yo, Ayase! Sorry, I'm in a hurry right now!
Ah. Could it be that you heard something regarding the school trip from Onee-san?
Eh? Why would Ayase know about this?
I've heard about the school trip while talking on the phone with Onee-san yesterday.
Onii-san isn't serious enough, so Onee-san was worried.
Guh... That Manami, you didn't say anything weird to Ayase right?
Ahh, I only heard about the school trip from Onee-san and nothing else, so don't worry.
Besides, my evaluation of Onii-san is already rock bottom, so it won't go any lower.
Ahaha...
...Even though I brought it upon myself, I can't get over it...
Now, now, don't just stand there and sulk. How about hurrying up?
Onee-san is waiting for you, isn't she?
T-That's right!
See you, Ayase!
Yes, see you next time.
